title: Monkey eating a snack
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <g>
    <!-- body -->
    <ellipse cx='50' cy='72' rx='20' ry='18' fill='#8B5A2B'/>
    <!-- belly -->
    <ellipse cx='50' cy='75' rx='13' ry='12' fill='#E8C39E'/>
    <!-- arms -->
    <ellipse cx='32' cy='66' rx='6' ry='9' fill='#8B5A2B' transform='rotate(20 32 66)'/>
    <ellipse cx='68' cy='66' rx='6' ry='9' fill='#8B5A2B' transform='rotate(-20 68 66)'/>
    <!-- legs -->
    <ellipse cx='40' cy='88' rx='7' ry='5' fill='#8B5A2B'/>
    <ellipse cx='60' cy='88' rx='7' ry='5' fill='#8B5A2B'/>
    <!-- feet -->
    <ellipse cx='38' cy='91' rx='5' ry='3' fill='#E8C39E'/>
    <ellipse cx='62' cy='91' rx='5' ry='3' fill='#E8C39E'/>
  </g>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='40' r='19' fill='#8B5A2B'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <circle cx='31' cy='38' r='6' fill='#8B5A2B'/>
  <circle cx='31' cy='38' r='3' fill='#E8C39E'/>
  <circle cx='69' cy='38' r='6' fill='#8B5A2B'/>
  <circle cx='69' cy='38' r='3' fill='#E8C39E'/>
  <!-- face patch -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='45' rx='14' ry='12' fill='#E8C39E'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='44' cy='37' r='2.6' fill='#3A2412'/>
  <circle cx='56' cy='37' r='2.6' fill='#3A2412'/>
  <circle cx='44.8' cy='36.2' r='0.9' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <circle cx='56.8' cy='36.2' r='0.9' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <!-- nostrils -->
  <circle cx='48' cy='43' r='0.9' fill='#8B5A2B'/>
  <circle cx='52' cy='43' r='0.9' fill='#8B5A2B'/>
  <!-- smiling mouth -->
  <path d='M44 47 Q50 52 56 47' stroke='#8B5A2B' stroke-width='1.6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- banana snack -->
  <path d='M45 52 Q50 58 58 55 Q54 50 48 50 Z' fill='#FFD93B'/>
  <path d='M45 52 Q50 58 58 55' stroke='#E6B800' stroke-width='1.2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- hands holding banana -->
  <circle cx='43' cy='54' r='4' fill='#8B5A2B'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='55' r='4' fill='#8B5A2B'/>
</svg>
